name: StepAudio 2.5 Realtime

voice.voices: 7 system voices (the same IDs as the 3 preview); the API reference also accepts cloned voices made with the StepAudio 2.5 TTS cloning API, while the model page says only the seven listed IDs are valid for this model; other voice values give a 400 error; the voice cannot change once the model has produced audio [step-25-realtime] [step-realtime-api]
languages: Chinese and English (the API page and the audio overview)
voice.turn_detection: Server VAD is off by default and is turned on with turn_detection.type server_vad: prefix_padding_ms default 500, silence_duration_ms default 100, energy_awakeness_threshold 0 to 5000 default 2500; otherwise the client commits the audio buffer and sends response.create [step-realtime-api]
voice.interruption: StepFun says server-side VAD lets the model answer on time and lets the user cut in during a reply; with VAD on, the server sends input_audio_buffer.speech_started; response.cancel cancels a response [step-25-realtime] [step-realtime-api]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: StepFun pricing page (read 2026-10-03), usage-based, per million tokens [step-pricing]
